column1: # Key of R9403 (ff. 226-228, 17 Sept 1531) as this letter's sign codes were written: the System B table with e and r exchanged.
# Added 16 Nov 2026 (decrypt audit). Every value is copied from the KEY table hard-coded in r9403/build.py (lines 6-7), the script that
# wrote r9403/transcription.tsv FROM the reading; NOTES.md, 'The key (System B)', states the exchange (e = starred x AST, r = plain x X).
# Because the codes of r9403/transcription.tsv were generated from the reading with this table, decrypting them with it returns the
# reading by construction: this file documents the table, it is not an independent check of the reading against the image.
# U2 is u and v. The word sign DAG (King John, by context) and the '?' of two part-words are not letter values and are not listed.
# The homophones of sysB/key_from_glosses.tsv (W for t, T for f) do not occur in r9403/transcription.tsv (not kept by build.py).
